newsitem.title: USA: Talley to pay preferred stock accrued divs.
newsitem.headline: Talley to pay preferred stock accrued divs.

text.p: Talley Industries Inc on Thursday said it will pay all dividend in arrears on its Series A and Series B preferred stock.
In addition, it will pay the quarterly dividend in December on the Series A preferred and the dividend payment in January on Series B preferred stock.

Dividend arrearage of $6.05 a share on the Series A will be paid on Dec. 2, to holders of record at the end of business on Nov. 18. The quarterly dividend will be paid on Dec. 16 to holders of record at the close of business on Dec. 2, 1996.
Dividend arrearage of $5.50 a share on the Series B preferred will be paid on Dec. 2, to holders of record at the close of business on Nov. 18, 1996.

"Payment of the preferred stock dividend arrearage, which totals $4.2 million, is an important step in improving our capital structure," William Mallender, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "Resuming the dividends on the preferred stock reflects our increased financial strength since the recent successful conclusion of our litigation with TRW Inc."
